posts.title: Installing SuSE 9.2 on an IBM ThinkCentre S50
posts.description: I feel I came prepared, when I wanted to finally install the SuSE 9.2 Linux Professional (Student Edition) that I had bought a month ago. I had a working ThinkCentre S50, I had my literature and experience with old Linux on old hardware. What could go wrong?
